name: [🎃] Rally Panic! [2 Player Rally]
desc:
New code at 2,000 likes! 

🏁 One drives. One navigates. Both panic.

Rally with a friend or Solo in this first-person, 2-player/Single Player rally game! The driver controls the steering and handbrake. The navigator holds the map and calls out turns, hazards, and which road to take.

🌲 Race through dense forests

🌉 Cross narrow bridges over deep ravines

🚧 Avoid wrong turns and dead ends

🗣️ Communicate fast and trust your teammate  

Choose your roles and work together to reach the finish. Can your friendship survive the next hairpin?

🎮 Inspired by "Left Left LEFT!" by Stellux Interactive. Thank you for the inspiration!

llm.loop: pick roles (driver/navigator) -> drive a rally stage through forests communicating turns -> reach finish -> earn coins and unlock cars and stages
llm.objectives: reach the finish of each rally stage together
llm.instructions: driver steers and handbrakes; navigator holds the map and calls out turns, hazards and roads; play with a friend or solo
unique: asymmetric driver/navigator co-op inspired by 'Left Left LEFT!'
llm.thumbnails: two panicked avatars in a rally car, one with a map, forest road through windshield
llm.complexity_notes: vehicle physics, multiple stage maps, two-role sync
